response.sql:
WITH category_averages AS (
  SELECT
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_difference
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
), category_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference
  FROM category_averages
)
SELECT
  AVG(ca.avg_quantity) AS average_category_quantity,
  AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference) AS average_category_cost_difference,
  AVG(ca.avg_cost_difference - cm.mean_cost_difference) AS average_excess_cost_difference
FROM category_averages AS ca
CROSS JOIN category_mean AS cm
WHERE ca.avg_cost_difference > cm.mean_cost_difference;

assumptions.assumption: `product_quantity` contains values that can be cast to a number; the mean cost difference is the average of non-NULL category average cost differences, with SQL aggregate NULL handling.
